paragraphs: Accessible, animated, zero-dependency rating components for React. Stars, hearts, smileys, numeric scales, thumbs and review summaries, with fractional precision, keyboard and touch support, RTL, native forms and SSR.
features: Interaction that feels right. The hover preview tracks the pointer at any precision (½, ¼, 0.1…). Fills cascade in and drain out, commits pop with a spring, and top scores can trigger a particle burst. Touch users can…

Accessible by default. Interactive ratings follow the WAI-ARIA slider pattern, with arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/Down, digits and Backspace. They announce text like "3.5 out of 5, Good". Read-only ratings are exposed as…
Tiny and dependency-free. No animation library and no CSS framework. Animations use CSS transitions and the Web Animations API on DOM nodes, so they cause no React re-renders.

More than stars. Built-in star, heart, circle, bolt, smiley and numeric icons; any SVG, emoji or render function; colour scales (red → green); ThumbsRating for helpful/not-helpful; and RatingSummary for review…
Headless when you need it. useRating() exposes all the state, pointer, keyboard and ARIA logic, so you can render any UI.
